Name: (AT CP DGA) RoseDryad's Pastel Magical Decor
Author: RoseDryad
Description:
Items include starry sky paintings, pastel rainbow wall decorations, moon and sky wall lights, moon lamps, a butterfly wall decoration, pink butterfly windows, a cloud plushie, pink shelves, pink tables, a pastel cloud chair and couches, pink star and heart dressers, pink hutches, and round rugs.

[b][u]Requirements:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url] *For SDV 1.5
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ *ONLY for SDV 1.6
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
[/list]
[b][u]DGA Notes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]DGA has some [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/issues]bugs[/url]﻿.
[*]Decorations turn into chairs when placed on tables (DGA bug)
[*]Not compatible with: CJB Item Spawner and stacking mods due to DGA having a different item system.
To spawn items, enter [font=Courier New]dga_store[/font] in the SMAPI console to open the DGA spawn menu.﻿﻿﻿[/list]
